independent_unit: Fresh service process. Per-process medians summarize nested batches.
ordering: Bsafe Q1, Bnew R1, Bnew R2, Bsafe Q2
batch_prefill_timing: batch_last_ttft_s spans the earliest request start through the last observed first SSE chunk. Its computed-input rate includes queueing, transport and concurrent decode work. Per-request server prefill durations are reported separately.
limits: Independent service-process count is2/arm. Statistical confidence is limited.
Request decode/prefill durations overlap for concurrent requests. System throughput uses the complete batch wall interval.
Computed prefill TPS is a per-request effective rate including scheduling. CUDA kernel timing is available in separate diagnostics.
Actual GPU step/bonus/truncation accounting is in the separate instrumented batch ledger.
